requirement_text.REQ-001a: GitHub issue #2 ("Translate to UZ" / "Add localization") requires Uzbek localization of the AI Qadam landing site. This requirement is the first of two: it proves the i18n MECHANISM end-to-end (dependency, routing, middleware, a working switcher) using only src/app/layout.tsx's strings as the seed catalog. REQ-001b (depends_on this requirement) extracts the remaining 12 landing components' copy once the mechanism is proven working. Translation quality is out of scope for both (that is REQ-002). Chosen approach: adopt next-intl as the i18n library. The switcher reuses the .nav/.nav-in/.lang classes already defined in src/app/globals.css (lines 36-51) -- this project's own bespoke CSS variable set, not the documented design-system tokens; stays on globals.css as-is. Scope: add next-intl dependency; restructure routing so src/app/page.tsx and src/app/layout.tsx move under src/app/[locale]/ with locale resolution proxy/middleware, ru default + uz second locale; create messages/ru.json and messages/uz.json seeded ONLY from src/app/layout.tsx's current strings (title, description, OG title/description/locale, Twitter title/description), uz values placeholder-duplicated from ru; replace Nav.tsx's non-functional RU/UZ/EN switcher with a working ru/uz-only switcher (drop EN) using next-intl's locale-aware routing helpers and only the existing .lang/.lang span/.lang .on classes; src/app/[locale]/layout.tsx sets <html lang> dynamically and localizes metadata title/description/OG locale (ru_RU/uz_UZ) from the message catalog; root / redirects to /ru.

result.summary: Implemented REQ-001a per docs/agents/design/REQ-001a.md. Installed next-intl@4.13.7. Resolved the open middleware/proxy question by inspecting the installed package directly: next-intl 4.13.7 only ships a `next-intl/middleware` export (no `next-intl/proxy` export exists in this version; its README has no mention of `proxy` at all), so its `createMiddleware(routing)` factory output is wrapped in a plain function, framework-signature-compatible with Next 16's Proxy convention. Per Next 16's own doc (node_modules/next/dist/docs/.../proxy.md), the file must be named proxy.ts with a default or named `proxy` export -- created that. Also discovered empirically (not documented) that Next's dev/build bundler resolves the middleware/proxy filename relative to the *parent of the app/pages directory*, not the true project root: since this project's app dir is src/app, proxy.ts had to live at src/proxy.ts (not repo-root proxy.ts) or it was silently never registered (confirmed via .next middleware-manifest.json being empty and via build output only showing 'ƒ Proxy (Middleware)' once moved). Also added `NextIntlClientProvider` wrapping {children} in src/app/[locale]/layout.tsx -- not explicit in the design's file tree (which lists no new provider), but required by next-intl's actual client-hook contract: LocaleSwitcher is a Client Component calling useLocale()/usePathname(), and without NextIntlClientProvider in the tree these throw at render (verified: caused a 500 before it was added, fixed after). This is a necessary wiring detail, not new structure/files, and is called out here per the design's own instruction not to silently deviate. Real command output -- `npm run lint`: '4 problems (0 errors, 4 warnings)' (all 4 warnings pre-existing @next/next/no-img-element and one pre-existing unused-var, none from new files), exit 0. `npm run build`: 'Compiled successfully in ~500ms', 'Finished TypeScript', route table shows '/_not-found' static, '/[locale]' dynamic, '/health' dynamic, and 'ƒ Proxy (Middleware)', exit 0. Verified via `npm run start` + curl: GET / -> 307 to /ru with Set-Cookie NEXT_LOCALE=ru; GET /ru -> 200, , switcher renders RUUZ, og:locale=ru_RU; GET /uz -> 200, , switcher shows UZ active, og:locale=uz_UZ; GET /health -> 200 {"status":"ok","service":"aiqadam-next"} unaffected. Also ran `docker build -t aiqadam-next:local .` (per deploy_guide.md #5 since next.config.ts changed) -- succeeded, and a container run of the built image confirmed /health and the / -> /ru redirect both work in the production Docker image; image and container removed after verification. Self-review per frontend_developer_guide.md #4: no raw hex colors introduced (globals.css diff is a single selector rename `.lang span` -> `.lang a`, same declaration block, no new values, per design section 3's explicit recommendation); no new spacing values; copy unchanged (no new copy invented, EN option dropped per requirement, title attribute removed per design's open question 5, left with no replacement rather than inventing copy). Two checks I could not perform and am stating explicitly rather than claiming: (a) 'checked in both light and dark theme' -- src/app/globals.css (the bespoke stylesheet this component uses, per the design's explicit choice) has no data-theme light/dark split at all, only a single fixed dark palette in :root with no [data-theme] rules anywhere in the file, so this check does not apply to this component as built (confirmed by grep -- 0 matches for data-theme in src/app/globals.css); (b) 'checked at mobile and desktop width' -- verified statically that .lang has no media-query override at either the 980px or 620px breakpoints in globals.css (only .nav-links hides at 980px), so no responsive breakage is expected, but I have no browser/viewport tool available to visually confirm actual rendered layout at specific widths, only curl-based HTML/HTTP inspection. No unrelated changes bundled in -- diff is scoped to the i18n restructure only.
issues: Deviation from design file tree: proxy.ts placed at src/proxy.ts, not project-root proxy.ts as the design's §1 file tree and §7 open-question-1 recommendation stated. Verified empirically that Next 16.3.2 resolves the middleware/proxy filename relative to the parent directory of app/ (i.e. src/, since app lives at src/app), not the true repository root -- a root-level proxy.ts is silently never registered (empty middleware-manifest.json, no proxy chunk in build output) with no warning or error. This is a correction to the design's assumption, not a freelance choice.

Addition not listed in the design's file tree: NextIntlClientProvider now wraps {children} in src/app/[locale]/layout.tsx. Required because LocaleSwitcher is a Client Component using next-intl's useLocale()/usePathname() hooks, which throw without a client provider in the tree (verified: 500 error before adding it, resolved after). Not a new file/component, just a required wrapper in the existing layout.

'.lang' has no data-theme light/dark variants in src/app/globals.css (single fixed dark palette only) -- the light/dark self-review checklist item does not apply to this component as scoped by the design's own decision to stay on the bespoke globals.css classes rather than the design-system's themed tokens.

No browser/viewport tool was available to visually verify responsive rendering at mobile/desktop widths -- verified statically via CSS media-query inspection only (no breakpoint hides or restyles .lang), not visually confirmed.
